title: squalify must include literal values only with --include-values, and never leak them otherwise
lead: It also adds `ValuesPolicy`, the single list of value-bearing descriptor members, and canary leak tests that every later format joins.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** sample rows (not planned); STDF MIR text (later item).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Goal: values are opt-in.

Owner decisions (2026-10-13):
- Numeric and temporal statistics are on by default.
- Lexical min/max, top-k values, preamble values and units-row text need the flag.

A single policy list plus a canary test means a new descriptor member cannot leak values unnoticed.

Sample-data review (2026-10-13), adopted by the owner (finding 6): product and program identity often lives in one or two preamble values or file-constant columns. A consumer needs those without opting in to every value, so values can be opted in per name.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/squalify/Fields/TopK.cs`:
  - Counts are exact while the distinct set is exact.
  - Past the cap, it switches to Space-Saving with 1,000 counters, keyed by value with `XxHash64` buckets (sq-11 shares it). That keeps the error at most N/1000.
  - Order: count descending, then ordinal value.
  - Output: `top[] {value, count}`, plus `approximate` and `maxError`.
- `FieldAccumulator`: `text {min, max}` (ordinal), only when the option is set for that field.
- `ProfileOptions.IncludeValuesFor` and the CLI option `--include-values-for <name>` (repeatable). Names are matched case-folded against preamble keys, annotation labels, key=value keys and field names (normalized as in sq-04). A match exposes only that member's values: a preamble or key=value value, an annotation label's row cells, or a field's `top`, `text` and withheld constant statistics (sq-05). A name that matches several members (for example a preamble key and a field) exposes all of them. A name that matches nothing gives the issue `includeValuesForUnmatched` with the unmatched names, sorted ordinally (the names come from the command line, not the data). `options.includeValuesFor` lists the names, sorted ordinally.
- `src/squalify/ValuesPolicy.cs`: lists every value-bearing member (region `values`, annotation row cells (sq-04), key=value values, Parquet KV values, comment text, `fields[].top`, `fields[].text`, `fields[].unit`, value-bearing `stableLines`, and `fields[].numeric` and `fields[].temporal` of a constant field (sq-05)). The writer refuses to write any of these when `includeValues` is false and the member's owner is not allow-listed, and throws `InvalidOperationException` (a bug, not a user error).
- Canary fixtures: `canary/canary.csv` and `canary/canary-preamble.csv`. Every string value, preamble value and annotation cell contains `CANARY`; header names do not. `canary.csv` also has a constant numeric column holding `987654321`.
- `docs/descriptor.md`: the "Values tier" table becomes normative. `docs/how-it-works.md` section 6.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
1. `Canary_NoValuesWithoutFlag` (theory over every canary fixture): without the flag the descriptor bytes do not contain `CANARY`; with the flag they do. Later format slices add rows.
2. `TopK_ExactOrderingAndTies`.
3. `TopK_SpaceSaving_ErrorBoundRespected`, using an injected small cap.
4. `ValuesPolicy_AllValueMembersRegistered`: reflection over the descriptor model checks each member marked `[ValueBearing]` against the policy list.
5. `Writer_RefusesValueMemberWithoutFlag`.
6. `Options_IncludeValues_RecordedInDescriptor`.
7. `AllowList_ExposesOnlyNamedMembers`: with `--include-values-for` naming one preamble key and one constant column of a canary fixture, only those two values contain `CANARY` in the output.
8. `Options_IncludeValuesFor_SortedInDescriptor`.
9. `Canary_ConstantNumeric_WithheldUnlessOptedIn`: `987654321` does not appear in the descriptor without the flag, and appears when that column is named in `--include-values-for`.
10. `AllowList_NameMatchesKeyAndField_ExposesBoth`.
11. `AllowList_UnmatchedName_Issue`.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the tests.
2. Implement `TopK`, the text min/max, `ValuesPolicy` and the writer guard.
3. Mutation checks: remove the gate on preamble values, and test 1 must go red. Match the allow-list by prefix instead of whole name, and test 7 must go red. Remove the constant-statistics entry from `ValuesPolicy`, and test 9 must go red.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `dotnet build squalify.sln -c Release`
- `dotnet test squalify.sln -c Release`
- `dotnet format squalify.sln --verify-no-changes`
- If this slice changed architecture (the pipeline, an interface, a descriptor section or a determinism rule), `docs/how-it-works.md` and its diagrams are updated and `./scripts/render-docs.sh` has been re-run. The architect confirms there is no drift.
- `slicer check`

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Worktree `.worktrees/sq-07` on branch `sq-07`. No agent commits. After the gate returns `VERDICT: PASS`, the orchestrator commits `sq-07: values tier` when the owner approves.
